body.title1: Guardianship of the Land | Baqueano Nicaragua
body.metaDescription1: The explorer's green decalogue, citizen environmental reports and a conservation passport in Nicaragua.

ambHeroExact.p1: Our forests, crater lagoons, rivers and communities are sacred. True tourism does not extract: it protects, respects and leaves the trail cleaner than it found it.

decalogoSeccion.p1: Small actions, big changes. Take on these 10 commandments and be part of Nicaragua's conservation.
decalogoSeccion.span3: Leave only footprints, take only memories.
decalogoSeccion.p2: I don't use bags or disposables. I carry my reusable bottle.
decalogoSeccion.p3: I leave no trash. I carry it with me to a recycling point.
decalogoSeccion.p4: I only walk on authorized trails.
decalogoSeccion.p5: I follow directions and look after the infrastructure.
decalogoSeccion.span4: Water and life give us a future.
decalogoSeccion.p6: I don't pollute rivers, lagoons, beaches or natural springs.
decalogoSeccion.p7: I don't remove plants or disturb animals.
decalogoSeccion.p8: I respect protected areas and regeneration zones.
decalogoSeccion.span5: The land is also its people.
decalogoSeccion.p9: I value their culture, customs and way of life.
decalogoSeccion.p10: I prefer local services and community experiences.
decalogoSeccion.h510: I am an ambassador of Nicaragua
decalogoSeccion.p11: I share good practices and encourage others to take care.
decalogoSeccion.p12: Take on the 10 commitments and receive your Nature Guardian badge.

alertaCiudadanaSeccion.p1: Help us protect Nicaragua's natural spaces. If you see an activity that harms the environment, you can report it confidentially.

body.metaDescription1: Legal framework, transparency and operating conditions of BAQUEANO, a digital platform committed to authentic, responsible and safe tourism in Nicaragua.

legalHeroSection.p1: Legal framework, transparency and operating conditions of BAQUEANO, a digital platform committed to authentic, responsible and safe tourism in Nicaragua.

essentialSection.h21: The essentials of the Legal Notice
essentialSection.p1: Learn the most important aspects of BAQUEANO's operation, use, intellectual property and regulatory framework.
essentialSection.p2: Operated from Managua, Nicaragua. National scope.
essentialSection.p3: Digital connection, information and facilitation between travelers and local providers.
essentialSection.p4: Independent initiative. It does not represent State institutions.
essentialSection.p5: Compliance with tourism, environmental, e-commerce and data protection laws.
essentialSection.p6: Protected brand, content, interfaces, code and database.

titularidad.p1: BAQUEANO is a digital platform operated and managed from Managua, Nicaragua, with reach across the entire national territory. It aims to promote sustainable tourism through technology, making it easier to connect travelers with local providers (entrepreneurs, guides, cooperatives, farms, lodgings, eateries and experiences).

naturaleza.p1: BAQUEANO is a technology platform for information, direct connection and digital facilitation. It does not provide tourism services directly; instead it offers tools so travelers can discover destinations, contact local providers and organize their experiences safely and responsibly.
naturaleza.p2: Verified tourism, cultural and natural content.
naturaleza.p3: Between travelers and local providers, without abuses.
naturaleza.p4: Routes, distances and points of interest in real time.

independencia.p1: BAQUEANO is an independent initiative and does not represent any government institution. Entities such as INTUR, MARENA, municipal governments, the National Police, Fire Department, Red Cross or other bodies are mentioned only for information purposes to guide the user. Their inclusion does not imply sponsorship, affiliation or official representation by those institutions.
independencia.strong1: BAQUEANO is not an official website of the State of Nicaragua.
independencia.p2: We are an independent platform focused on promoting sustainable and community tourism.

marcoNormativo.p1: BAQUEANO's operation is governed by the legislation in force in the Republic of Nicaragua, including:
marcoNormativo.p2: Establishes the framework for the development, regulation and promotion of tourism in Nicaragua.
marcoNormativo.p3: Promotes the development of sustainable tourism investments and activities.
marcoNormativo.p4: Regulates the conservation of natural resources and the sustainable use of environmental heritage.
marcoNormativo.p5: Regulates digital transactions, the validity of electronic information and online services.

propiedadIntelectual.p1: All content, design, logo, visual identity, interfaces, source code, database, texts, photographs, maps, icons and other elements of BAQUEANO are protected by intellectual property and copyright laws. Their reproduction, distribution, modification or unauthorized use without the prior written consent of the owner is prohibited.
